title: The Lonely Sea · Chapter One (Lighthouse Visitor)

root-d1.speaker: Alice
root-d1.text: ...Ah, you have arrived. Leave the sound of the ocean outside by the door.

root-d2.speaker: Alice
root-d2.text: Master is still wrestling with this Blog, so I will be guiding you today.

root-d3.speaker: Alice
root-d3.text: Which part would you like to see first?

site-d1.speaker: Alice
site-d1.text: The Lonely Sea is Master's personal archive for preserving essays and memories.

site-d2.speaker: Alice
site-d2.text: Technology and Web creation, anime, games, diaries—though their entrances differ, they all flow into the same sea.

site-load-d1.speaker: Alice
site-load-d1.text: This is the active LOAD interface. Reading positions for essays, game save files, and diary records are managed separately here.

site-load-d2.speaker: Alice
site-load-d2.text: When saving a game, the save file captures the scene at that moment; loading brings you straight back to that exact fragment.

site-extra-d1.speaker: Alice
site-extra-d1.text: EXTRA is the archive room unlocked after viewing: CGs, music, project records, Bangumi, videos, and character profiles are all accessed from here.

site-option-d1.speaker: Alice
site-option-d1.text: OPTION is divided into System, Game, and Blog. Text speed, audio, animations, and cursor styles are saved instantly and synchronized with the game.

site-vn-d1.speaker: Alice
site-vn-d1.text: The guide you are viewing right now is itself Chapter 1 of the visual novel, sharing saves, settings, and return logic with the Blog.

site-vn-d2.speaker: Alice
site-vn-d2.text: The game's title, save, and option menus do not branch off separately; they lead right back to their corresponding pages on the Blog.

more-history-d.speaker: Alice
more-history-d.text: The Lonely Sea evolved from a simple personal blog into the current Galgame-style reader; older versions remain as history rather than pretending to be the present.

more-progress-d.speaker: Alice
more-progress-d.text: Current priorities are stabilizing Chapter 1, save thumbnails, CONTINUE, settings synchronization, and reliable Studio exports.

more-scraps-d.speaker: Alice
more-scraps-d.text: Unused layouts and interactions are organized into design archives, preventing us from repeating the same missteps in future iterations.

more-support-d.speaker: Alice
more-support-d.text: The tipping portal is not ready yet. Once the official page is published, any payment methods will strictly follow the Blog's public notices.

system-d1.speaker: Alice
system-d1.text: These are the features actively invoked between the Blog and the game.

system-comment-d.speaker: Alice
system-comment-d.text: Leaving a message calls the Blog's native input interface; text is saved locally on this device and will not pretend to be sent to external services.

system-links-d.speaker: Alice
system-links-d.text: Friend links can be viewed here, and you can submit site names and URLs; before server integration, submissions remain local.

system-rss-d.speaker: Alice
system-rss-d.text: RSS is connected to the Blog's live article feed at /rss.xml; new posts are added to the feed whenever the site is redeployed.

system-lab-d.speaker: Alice
system-lab-d.text: The Game Testing Ground is the live validation area for this Studio and Blog Bridge. Every exported release has a unique build number and integrity check.

master-d2.speaker: Alice
master-d2.text: I will not make up answers about things Master has not publicly shared just to fill up menu slots.

master-work-d.speaker: Alice
master-work-d.text: The clearest focus right now is connecting the Blog, the Studio, and this guided game into a unified system.

master-contact-d.speaker: Alice
master-contact-d.text: Public contact details should be checked against the Blog's officially published pages. Unverified accounts will not be listed here.

interest-anime-d.speaker: Alice
interest-anime-d.text: Anime records are cataloged in articles and Bangumi archives; yearly summaries and watch history are answered by real data.

interest-game-d.speaker: Alice
interest-game-d.text: Gaming records include playthrough impressions as well as technical experiments like integrating this visual novel into the Blog.

master-more-d1.speaker: Alice
master-more-d1.text: The items beyond here are more personal. Without Master's original manuscripts, I only mark the doorways without recounting his life for him.

mm-computer-d.speaker: Alice
mm-computer-d.text: Computer science and web engineering will gradually be documented through technical essays, project logs, and actual source code.

mm-devices-d.speaker: Alice
mm-devices-d.text: The software and hardware inventory has not been verified by Master, so the current build avoids speculative placeholders.

mm-name-d.speaker: Alice
mm-name-d.text: A dedicated doorway exists for the origin of 'Asashiki', but the full story awaits Master's own words.

mm-private-d.speaker: Alice
mm-private-d.text: This page requires Master's personal writing. When the manuscript is ready, I will preserve its nuances faithfully.

mm-feed-d.speaker: Alice
mm-feed-d.text: Tipping portals also await the official page. No payment or account details will be fabricated by me.

alice-d1.speaker: Alice
alice-d1.text: I am Alice. Living in this lighthouse, I connect visitors to the Blog and the stories within.

alice-d2.speaker: Alice
alice-d2.text: I call Asashiki 'Master'. As for our guests, I remain polite—and occasionally make gentle, quiet jokes.

alice-d3.speaker: Alice
alice-d3.text: Please start wherever you feel drawn to. I will remain right here, waiting for your return.

alice-duty-d.speaker: Alice
alice-duty-d.text: I guide visitors, explain features, and return requests to the Blog whenever the game calls for saves, settings, or exits.

alice-home-d.speaker: Alice
alice-home-d.text: This is a room inside the lighthouse. Outside is the sea, and on the desk rest unfinished archives.
